notes.title: First Update
notes.content:
Hello, agents.

We are happy to announce our first update today!

The game contains fast blinking images that may not be suitable for photosensitive syndrome. Therefore, this update includes a selection screen before starting the game so that users can enjoy the game more safely.
Our team will do our best to make the game more enjoyable and safer. Thank you for your warm love and feedback.



OZNA STUDIO
